Apple___Apple_scab.label: Apple___Apple_scab
Apple___Apple_scab.summary: A fungal disease causing dark scabby lesions on leaves and fruit.
treatments: Apply a protectant fungicide (e.g. captan or sulfur) from green tip through first cover.
Rake and destroy fallen leaves to reduce overwintering inoculum.
prevention: Choose scab-resistant cultivars.
Prune for airflow; avoid wetting foliage when irrigating.

Apple___Black_rot.label: Apple___Black_rot
Apple___Black_rot.summary: Fungal disease causing frog-eye leaf spots, black fruit rot, and cane cankers.
treatments: Apply captan or thiophanate-methyl during bloom and cover sprays.
Remove mummified fruit and cankered wood.
prevention: Prune out dead/diseased wood.
Maintain a balanced nutrition program.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.label: Apple___Cedar_apple_rust
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.summary: Fungal disease needing both apple and cedar hosts; bright orange leaf spots.
treatments: Apply myclobutanil or ferbam from pink bud through petal fall.
Remove nearby juniper/cedar galls where feasible.
prevention: Plant rust-resistant apple cultivars.
Avoid planting apples near eastern red cedar.

Apple___healthy.label: Apple___healthy
Apple___healthy.summary: No disease symptoms detected on this leaf.
prevention: Continue routine monitoring and balanced care.

Blueberry___healthy.label: Blueberry___healthy
Blueberry___healthy.summary: No disease symptoms detected on this leaf.
prevention: Maintain acidic soil (pH 4.5-5.5) and mulch.

Cherry___Powdery_mildew.label: Cherry___Powdery_mildew
Cherry___Powdery_mildew.summary: Fungal disease forming white powdery growth on leaves and shoots.
treatments: Apply sulfur or a powdery-mildew-specific fungicide at early symptom onset.
prevention: Prune for airflow; avoid excess nitrogen.
Space plants to reduce humidity.

Cherry___healthy.label: Cherry___healthy
Cherry___healthy.summary: No disease symptoms detected on this leaf.
prevention: Continue routine monitoring and balanced care.

Corn___Cercospora_gray_leaf_spot.label: Corn___Cercospora_gray_leaf_spot
Corn___Cercospora_gray_leaf_spot.summary: Fungal disease producing rectangular gray-tan lesions bounded by leaf veins.
treatments: Apply a foliar fungicide (e.g. azoxystrobin or pyraclostrobin) if infection is active before tasseling.
prevention: Rotate crops and incorporate residue.
Plant resistant hybrids.

Corn___Common_rust.label: Corn___Common_rust
Corn___Common_rust.summary: Fungal disease causing cinnamon-brown pustules on both leaf surfaces.
treatments: Apply a fungicide if rust appears early and on susceptible hybrids.
prevention: Plant resistant hybrids.
Monitor during cool humid weather.

Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.label: Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight
Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.summary: Fungal disease causing long cigar-shaped gray-green lesions.
treatments: Apply a foliar fungicide at early lesion onset.
Rotate crops and bury residue.
prevention: Plant resistant hybrids.
Reduce continuous corn.

Corn___healthy.label: Corn___healthy
Corn___healthy.summary: No disease symptoms detected on this leaf.
prevention: Continue routine monitoring and balanced care.

Grape___Black_rot.label: Grape___Black_rot
Grape___Black_rot.summary: Fungal disease causing leaf lesions with black fruiting bodies and berry mummification.
treatments: Apply captan, mancozeb, or myclobutanil from bud break through berry touch.
prevention: Remove mummified berries and prune for airflow.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).label: Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles)
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).summary: Chronic/vascular disease causing tiger-stripe leaves and dark-pitted berries.
treatments: No reliable cure; protect pruning wounds with a wound-protectant fungicide.
prevention: Remove severely affected vines.
Avoid large pruning cuts in wet weather.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.label: Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spot)
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.summary: Fungal disease causing angular necrotic leaf spots with dark spore masses.
treatments: Apply mancozeb, captan, or myclobutanil at bloom and pre-bunch closing.
prevention: Remove infected leaves and maintain canopy airflow.

Grape___healthy.label: Grape___healthy
Grape___healthy.summary: No disease symptoms detected on this leaf.
prevention: Continue routine monitoring and balanced care.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).label: Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening)
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).summary: Bacterial, systemic, insect-vectored disease causing blotchy mottle and bitter fruit.
treatments: No cure: remove confirmed infected trees to slow spread.
Control the Asian citrus psyllid vector with approved insecticides.
prevention: Use certified disease-free nursery stock.
Manage psyllid populations area-wide.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.label: Peach___Bacterial_spot
Peach___Bacterial_spot.summary: Bacterial disease causing angular leaf spots, yellowing, and fruit cracking.
treatments: Apply copper or oxytetracycline at fall leaf drop and/or early bloom (per local regulations).
prevention: Plant resistant cultivars.
Avoid overhead irrigation.

Peach___healthy.label: Peach___healthy

Pepper_bell___Bacterial_spot.label: Pepper_bell___Bacterial_spot
Pepper_bell___Bacterial_spot.summary: Bacterial disease causing water-soaked leaf spots that turn brown and necrotic.
treatments: Apply copper + mancozeb sprays (resistance is common; rotate products).
prevention: Use disease-free seed and transplants.
Avoid overhead irrigation and working with wet plants.

Pepper_bell___healthy.label: Pepper_bell___healthy
Pepper_bell___healthy.summary: No disease symptoms detected on this leaf.
prevention: Continue routine monitoring and balanced care.

Potato___Early_blight.label: Potato___Early_blight
Potato___Early_blight.summary: Fungal disease causing dark target-ring lesions on lower leaves first.
treatments: Apply chlorothalonil, mancozeb, or azoxystrobin on a 7-10 day schedule.
prevention: Rotate crops (2-3 years out of solanaceous crops).
Maintain plant vigor with adequate nitrogen.

Potato___Late_blight.label: Potato___Late_blight
Potato___Late_blight.summary: Oomycete disease causing water-soaked lesions with white sporulation; devastates quickly.
treatments: Apply a late-blight-specific fungicide (e.g. cymoxanil, fluopicolide) preventively or at first sign.
Destroy infected plants to limit spread.
prevention: Use certified seed tubers.
Avoid overhead irrigation; hill plants to cover tubers.

prevention: Continue routine monitoring and balanced care.

Raspberry___healthy.label: Raspberry___healthy
Raspberry___healthy.summary: No disease symptoms detected on this leaf.
prevention: Prune canes for airflow; maintain weed control.

Soybean___healthy.label: Soybean___healthy
Soybean___healthy.summary: No disease symptoms detected on this leaf.
prevention: Rotate crops; scout during reproductive stages.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.label: Squash___Powdery_mildew
Squash___Powdery_mildew.summary: Fungal disease causing white powdery colonies on upper leaf surfaces.
treatments: Apply sulfur or a targeted fungicide (e.g. myclobutanil) at first sign.
prevention: Plant resistant cultivars.
Space plants for airflow and avoid excess nitrogen.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.label: Strawberry___Leaf_scorch
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.summary: Fungal disease causing purple-bordered, scorched-looking leaf spots.
treatments: Apply captan, myclobutanil, or thiophanate-methyl at early symptom onset.
prevention: Remove old/diseased leaves after harvest.
Improve air drainage and avoid overhead irrigation.

Strawberry___healthy.label: Strawberry___healthy
Strawberry___healthy.summary: No disease symptoms detected on this leaf.
prevention: Continue routine monitoring and balanced care.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.label: Tomato___Bacterial_spot
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.summary: Bacterial disease causing small water-soaked spots that become raised and necrotic.
treatments: Apply copper + mancozeb sprays (rotate to manage resistance).
prevention: Use disease-free seed; hot-water seed treatment.
Avoid overhead irrigation and wet handling.

Tomato___Early_blight.label: Tomato___Early_blight
Tomato___Early_blight.summary: Fungal disease with target-ring lesions on older leaves; progresses upward.
treatments: Apply chlorothalonil or copper on a 7-10 day schedule from first symptom.
prevention: Mulch to prevent soil splash.
Stake plants and rotate crops.

Tomato___Late_blight.label: Tomato___Late_blight
Tomato___Late_blight.summary: Oomycete disease causing large greasy lesions; can kill plants in days.
treatments: Apply a late-blight-specific fungicide preventively; destroy infected plants.
prevention: Use certified transplants.
Avoid overhead irrigation; space for airflow.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.label: Tomato___Leaf_Mold
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.summary: Fungal disease of the lower canopy; olive velvety sporulation on leaf undersides.
treatments: Apply chlorothalonil or copper; improve ventilation.
prevention: Increase greenhouse ventilation and reduce humidity.
Remove lower infected leaves.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.label: Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.summary: Fungal disease causing many small circular spots with dark borders and gray centers.
treatments: Apply chlorothalonil or mancozeb every 7-10 days.
prevention: Mulch around plants; remove lower infected leaves.
Rotate crops and avoid overhead irrigation.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.label: Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider_mite
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.summary: Mite pest causing fine stippling and webbing; leaves look dusty and yellowed.
treatments: Release predatory mites or apply an appropriate miticide (avoid flaring with broad insecticides).
prevention: Hose off foliage; avoid dusty, hot, dry conditions.
Monitor undersides of leaves.

Tomato___Target_Spot.label: Tomato___Target_Spot
Tomato___Target_Spot.summary: Fungal disease causing dark target-like lesions; thrives in humid conditions.
treatments: Apply chlorothalonil, azoxystrobin, or mancozeb at early symptom onset.
prevention: Improve airflow; reduce leaf wetness.
Remove infected tissue.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.label: Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.summary: Whitefly-vectored viral disease causing yellow, curled, stunted leaves.
treatments: No cure: remove infected plants.
Control whiteflies with approved insecticides and reflective mulch.
prevention: Use virus-resistant cultivars.
Exclude whiteflies with row covers in nurseries.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.label: Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.summary: Contact-transmitted virus causing mottled, malformed leaves.
treatments: No cure: remove infected plants and disinfect tools.
Use virus-free seed and resistant cultivars.
prevention: Do not smoke/handle tobacco near tomatoes.
Sanitize tools and hands between plants.

Tomato___healthy.label: Tomato___healthy
Tomato___healthy.summary: No disease symptoms detected on this leaf.
prevention: Continue routine monitoring and balanced care.
